profile.headline: Lead Software Developer | .Net Full Stack | SharePoint | Angular | Pivotal Cloud Foundry | Agile
profile.summary:
Purposeful IT professional with over 20 years of experience in IT support, full-life cycle Client/Server development, web development, and cloud architecture. Proficient in full-stack development, including .NET, .NET Core, C#, Angular, and SQL. Experience with AWS and Azure services. Expertise in owning and supporting a SharePoint portal utilized by GM dealers in about 119 countries in eighteen different market groups. Strong communicator with the ability to collaborate effectively with business partners and cross-functional teams. Solutions driven and committed to excellence and quality work. Enjoy teamwork, coaching and sharing experiences to ensure the successful execution of complex projects.

SKILLS: 
C#, ASP.Net MVC,  ASP.Net Core,  ASP.Net Core Web API,  ADO.Net/Entity Framework,  SharePoint,  SQL Server, IIS, TFS, HTML, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, Angular2, Typescript, Bootstrap, XML, JSON, STSADM, and PowerShell
